description: Video of the walk-though https://youtu.be/0fUhg0EGS9k Subject : Walking though the Esperaza market with Binaural microphones. Date : 2024 03 17 near 11h55 Location : Esperaza Aude France. On a balcony Notes : Walking from the bridge to Rue Barbes. Credit to "Maxence des Oiseaux" for the bird sounds at 2:55. Sorry I don't know the other musicians we hear as I walk by. Hardware : Zoom H5 as recorder, Soundman OKM I Processing : Trim and normalized, on Audacity 3.4.2. Tips : May want a HPF to get rid of a bit of rumble / wind Attribution is greatly appreciated but not required. Recommendation : X sound by Sadiquecat on Freesound.org Hope you enjoy :) PS: Id love to hear how you use this sound, feel free to link your creations or share how/why you listen to this :)
name: Esperaza Market Binaural walkthough
